Our multidisciplinary teams use agile methodologies to rapidly and incrementally deliver value in close collaboration with our clients. Description
Spend your summer shipping real software. In Capital Technology Group's 8-week hybrid internship, you'll first join an agile team building features for a live CTG Labs product. Then you'll pitch and build your own AI-powered project, with mentorship from CTG engineers and a Claude license for AI-assisted development.
We're looking for curious, driven undergraduate and graduate students who love to build. You won't be fetching coffee or watching from the sidelines. You'll own real features on projects that support mission-critical work, side by side with experienced engineers who are invested in your success.
🛠️ What you'll build: Two phases, one summer. In weeks 1 to 4, you'll work as an agile team shipping features off the backlog of a live CTG Labs product, likely across Python, React, and AWS, while shaping a pitch for your own project. In weeks 5 to 8, you'll design, build, and ship that AI-powered project yourself, aimed at a real problem in the federal space.
🤝 Who you'll build with: You'll join a summer cohort of software development, data engineering, and business development interns. Look forward to a weekly speaker series with CTG engineers and leaders covering software fundamentals, DevOps, data workflows, and user-centered design, plus career training on resumes, interviewing, and networking.
🎤 How you'll finish: The summer wraps with Final Demo Day, where you present your AI project to the company and show off everything you learned along the way.
📅 The details: 8 weeks, full time (40 hours per week), June 21 through August 13. Hybrid, with 3 days together in our Silver Spring, Maryland office and the rest of the week remote.
Your Path to CTG
📍 Location: Hybrid, Silver Spring, MD You'll join us in the office 3 days a week, so make sure you can commute to Silver Spring this summer.
🚨 Deadline: Monday, January 4 at 11:59 PM ET Don't wait! We review applications on a rolling basis and may close early, so the sooner you apply, the better.
💥 Take-Home Challenge Selected candidates get a take-home challenge, your chance to show us how you build. You'll have one week to accept the invite and up to 3 days to complete it once you start.
📞 December and January: Let's Connect! If you advance, you'll have a short call with our recruiting team, followed by interviews with our team. Interviews happen on a rolling basis and may start as early as December, with most taking place in January.

At CTG, you'll earn while you learn, work alongside a team that champions creativity and innovation, and gain hands-on experience that sets you apart.
